narrative_prose: Silas methodically tightened the brass calipers against the mounting bracket, observing the magnetohydrodynamic Kelvin-Helmholtz shear across the ferrofluid sea dragging the metallic surface into impossible, jagged geometric formations. The sharp tang of scorched ozone insulation hung thick in the air, complementing the violent, crackling hiss of the shear wave that drowned out the steady thrum of the ridge generators. He ignored the intense static prickling across his forearms and the metallic bite of ambient charge on his tongue, carefully choosing to CONCEAL the primary sensor array within the protective trench to DEFEND it from the escalating magnetic anomaly. Stepping back as a particularly aggressive magnetic surge washed over the bulkhead, he signaled to ATTRACT Hector's attention, preparing to pass the reinforced baton to the incoming stormbreaker.
summary: Silas secures the outpost equipment against the magnetohydrodynamic shear before handing off the baton to Hector.
